'''Seatrooper armor''', also known as '''Stormtrooper Aquatic Armor''',<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref> was a lightweight [[Armor/Legends|armor]] worn by [[Aquatic assault stormtrooper]]s.

It was a lightweight [[Color/Legends|white]] armor covering a two-piece black [[Environment suit/Legends|environment suit]] that had an air supply lasting for over an hour. The helmet incorporated a [[Macrobinocular viewplate/Legends|macrobinocular viewplate]] with an integrated [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] array, and breathing apparatus linked to a portable [[environment unit]] with inbuilt [[Power cell/Legends|power cell pack]] and [[propulsion unit]]. [[Propulsion boot]]s incorporated snap-down [[flipper]]s, giving the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] increased movement underwater. The armor was partially resistant to physical and energy attacks, since the armor was designed to withstand crushing ocean depths. The [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] wore a standard [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]], and was armed with a [[blaster speargun]] (a modified [[E-11]] that doubles as a [[Spear gun|speargun]]) and [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenades]].
